headline: Ukraine Central Bank Head Pyshny Cooperates With Anti-Corruption Probe
summary: National Bank of Ukraine Governor Andriy Pyshny stated that anti-corruption bureau searches of his workspace found no violations, affirming he will stay in office.
why: The National Bank of Ukraine steers the country's monetary policy and financial system stability amid extensive international financial assistance.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Governance integrity at the central bank is critical to maintaining donor trust and macroeconomic stabilization.
